Pyre Movie Review (2026) | Vinod Kapri | A Heartbreaking Story of Love, Loneliness & Migration
Can a small-budget film deliver a bigger emotional impact than a grand cinematic spectacle?
In this Hindi review of Pyre, we explore Vinod Kapri's deeply moving film about an elderly couple, Padam and Tulsi, living in a nearly abandoned village in Uttarakhand's Kumaon region. As their son stays away and their village slowly empties, they confront ageing, loneliness, love and the fear of losing each other.
